name: CpmPhys
description:
Representation of a single interaction of the Cpm type: storage for relevant parameters.

 Evolution of the contact is governed by Law2_ScGeom_CpmPhys_Cpm, that includes damage effects and chages of parameters inside CpmPhys. See cpm-model<CpmMat> for details.

attributes.name: E
attributes.description: normal modulus (stiffness / crossSection) [Pa]

attributes.name: G
attributes.description: shear modulus [Pa]

attributes.name: tanFrictionAngle
attributes.description: tangens of internal friction angle [-]

attributes.name: undamagedCohesion
attributes.description: virgin material cohesion [Pa]

attributes.name: crossSection
attributes.description: equivalent cross-section associated with this contact [m²]

attributes.name: refLength
attributes.description: initial length of interaction [m]

attributes.name: refPD
attributes.description: initial penetration depth of interaction [m] (used with ScGeom)

attributes.name: epsCrackOnset
attributes.description: strain at which the material starts to behave non-linearly

attributes.name: relDuctility
attributes.description: Relative ductility of bonds in normal direction

attributes.name: epsFracture
attributes.description: strain at which the bond is fully broken [-]

attributes.name: equivStrainShearContrib
attributes.description: Coefficient of shear contribution to equivalent strain

attributes.name: dmgTau
attributes.description: characteristic time for damage (if non-positive, the law without rate-dependence is used)

attributes.name: dmgRateExp
attributes.description: exponent in the rate-dependent damage evolution

attributes.name: dmgStrain
attributes.description: damage strain (at previous or current step)

attributes.name: dmgOverstress
attributes.description: damage viscous overstress (at previous step or at current step)

attributes.name: plTau
attributes.description: characteristic time for viscoplasticity (if non-positive, no rate-dependence for shear)

attributes.name: plRateExp
attributes.description: exponent in the rate-dependent viscoplasticity

attributes.name: isoPrestress
attributes.description: "prestress" of this link (used to simulate isotropic stress)

attributes.name: neverDamage
attributes.description: the damage evolution function will always return virgin state

attributes.name: damLaw
attributes.description: Law for softening part of uniaxial tension. 0 for linear, 1 for exponential (default)

attributes.name: isCohesive
attributes.description: if not cohesive, interaction is deleted when distance is greater than zero.

attributes.name: omega
attributes.description: Damage internal variable (auto-updated)

attributes.name: Fn
attributes.description: Magnitude of normal force (auto-updated)

attributes.name: Fs
attributes.description: Magnitude of shear force (auto-updated)

attributes.name: epsN
attributes.description: Current normal strain (auto-updated)

attributes.name: epsT
attributes.description: Current shear strain (auto-updated)

attributes.name: sigmaN
attributes.description: Current normal stress (auto-updated)

attributes.name: sigmaT
attributes.description: Current shear stress (auto-updated)

attributes.name: kappaD
attributes.description: Up to now maximum normal strain (semi-norm), non-decreasing in time (auto-updated)

attributes.name: epsNPl
attributes.description: normal plastic strain (initially zero) (auto-updated)

attributes.name: epsTPl
attributes.description: shear plastic strain (initially zero) (auto-updated)

attributes.name: relResidualStrength
attributes.description: Relative residual strength (auto-updated)

attributes.name: ks
attributes.description: Shear stiffness

attributes.name: shearForce
attributes.description: Shear force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: kn
attributes.description: Normal stiffness

attributes.name: normalForce
attributes.description: Normal force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: funcG
methods.description: Damage evolution law, evaluating the $\omega$ parameter. $\kappa_D$ is historically maximum strain, *epsCrackOnset* ($\varepsilon_0$) = CpmPhys.epsCrackOnset, *epsFracture* = CpmPhys.epsFracture; if *neverDamage* is ``True``, the value returned will always be 0 (no damage). TODO

methods.name: funcGInv
methods.description: Inversion of damage evolution law, evaluating the $\kappa_D$ parameter. $\omega$ is damage, for other parameters see funcG function
